Hi Oliver — thanks for the quick send and the attachments. A couple of procurement/tax questions so we can move this forward cleanly: 

1) Entity classification: Is Greenridge Labs Ltd a UK tax resident operating as a foreign entity to the US? 2) Alternate acceptance: Our tax team sometimes accepts a certified government registry extract (Companies House) in lieu of notarization for UK entities. That path requires the registry extract to be a PDF certified by Companies House (not just a screenshot).

3) PO provisioning: Procurement can issue a provisional PO (PO-PROV-XXXXX) to unblock shipments if we receive one of the above sets (notarized W-8BEN-E OR Companies House certified extract + bank letter) and the completed onboarding form. Please fill the onboarding form at the link below — once submitted, we can queue the PO for review.

Thanks team — quick procurement/tax decision so we can keep timelines: 

1) Acceptance policy: For UK non-US entities, Redwood Procurement will accept the Companies House certified extract + bank confirmation letter in place of a notarized W-8BEN-E. That combination satisfies our treasury KYC and tax team's documentary requirements to issue a full PO (not provisional), provided the following checks pass:
   - The Companies House extract exactly matches the legal name on bank records and the invoice header.
   - The extract shows at least one current director whose name matches the authorized signer on the W-8 (if a W-8 is provided).
   - Bank letter displays account name and routing for international wire (IBAN/SWIFT) and is dated within the last 90 days.

2) Next steps for Greenridge: Please upload the certified Companies House extract (PDF) and a dated bank confirmation letter, and complete the procurement_onboarding_form.pdf at the Drive link. Once uploaded to our secure onboarding folder we will run the checks and, assuming everything verifies, issue PO-2026-1498 (net45 standard terms).

3) Interim provisioning: Because Greenridge indicated a delivery timeline in October, Procurement can provision a provisional PO to allow scheduling (PO-PROV-2026-0910). This provisional PO will be converted to the full PO once paperwork validates. If notarized W-8BEN-E is later provided, we will attach it to the file but it is not required to convert the provisional PO if the registry+bank docs meet the checks above.

4) Contact points:
- Tax validation: david_kim@redwood.ai (cc'd)
- Procurement owner: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
